rEquityTool: Wealth Scores and Wealth Quintiles from 'EquityTool' Questionnaires

Source: R/utils.R
rEquityTool-package.Rd

Reads the country workbooks published by the 'EquityTool' (https://equitytool.org), a simplified asset-based measure of relative household wealth derived from Demographic and Health Survey and Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey wealth indices, and applies them to survey data. Given a data frame of respondent answers, the package computes the 'EquityTool' wealth score and assigns respondents to wealth quintiles using the published national, urban or rural cut-points, or using the sample's own weighted score distribution when relative position within the surveyed population is the quantity of interest. Response coding is validated before scoring, and score tables are cross-checked against the two independent representations of them in each workbook.
